Kiro CLI documentation excerpt, NOT a captured executable help fixture.
Sources: https://kiro.dev/docs/reference/cli-commands.md and https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/chat/session-management.md (retrieved 2026-09-10)

kiro-cli chat [OPTIONS] [INPUT]
--resume -r Resume the previous conversation from this directory
--resume-picker Open interactive session picker to choose which session to resume
--resume-id <ID> Resume a specific session by its ID
--list-sessions List all saved sessions for the current directory
--trust-all-tools Trust all tools without prompting
--trust-tools Trust specified tools
--no-interactive Run without interactive prompts
--agent <NAME> Specify the agent to use

When you exit a session, Kiro CLI prints the session ID along with the command to resume it:
kiro-cli chat --resume-id abc123-def456
